scope: One childless AC1027 DXF-origin FIELD referenced by one TABLECONTENT type-2 value and rewritten by dx_iface.

sourceProfile.rawTypedIdentity: One successful import receipt pairs the single typed FIELD to the single raw FIELD by handle, owner, family and source version; its ordered 24-group schema is checked.
sourceProfile.genericAutoCadFieldGraph: Not complete: the source intentionally has no FIELDLIST. Admission is limited to the exact childless direct TABLECONTENT reference profile.

rewriteAndReadback.physicalOutput: The rewritten FIELD precedes its TABLECONTENT consumer; the consumer writes type 2 and exact group-340 target 2740.
rewriteAndReadback.typedReadback: The rewritten FIELD and TABLECONTENT are decoded; the type-2 content handle resolves to FIELD 2740.
rewriteAndReadback.failureAndRetry: Mutating the imported typed FIELD handle breaks its raw/typed identity pair; export refuses with destination-sentinel preservation. Restoring the source identity succeeds on the same adapter.

validation.focusedOutput: Generated DATALINK writer and adapter routes: PASS

limitations: Only the exact AC1027 childless FIELD schema and same-encoding ASCII or binary rewrite are qualified. FIELDLIST, children, object references, child values, other owners, versions and cross-encoding rewrites remain outside this profile.
A cached FIELD string does not establish expression evaluation or native CAD rendering.
The overall TABLECONTENT implementation remains a bounded subset; TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP, units, margins, borders, other cell compositions and native rendering are not established.
